name: UtilityBar - Derived Cities
description: The crimson strip above the header, reading the same derived chapter labels the menu does. This line used to be built by hunting nav.json for a group called Chapters, so it went stale invisibly whenever the chapter list moved on — DC and DMV Area is the label that was wrong before this change. Captured at both widths because the strip now renders TWO lines and swaps them with CSS alone: the Desktop frame is the full list, the Mobile frame is the lede by itself. The full line is about seventy characters of letter-spaced monospace, which wrapped to three lines on a 390px phone and spent a third of the first screen before the visitor reached the logo. The owner chose the bare lede over a chapter count on 2026-09-28 — the two frames side by side are what that decision looks like.
